meta.title: Countering above the vendor's price depends on the reversal setting
gaps: it depends on a company setting this run does not change (RFQ trade config allow_price_reversal_in_counter_offer_in_rfq = false) — a failure is reported as couldn't tell, not as a bug

words.preconditions: A fresh published RFQ event where the invited QA vendor has submitted a bid; bidding still open.
steps: The buyer sends the “counter the vendor's price” request, exactly as the matching library case writes it.
words.expected: The app refuses the step the case is about with “You cannot increase the price”, and never with a server error.
